user.title: 🪟 HA Window – step 1 of 5: shade
user.description:
![]({obrazki}/kreator-pasek-1-en.png)

Pick the shade of this window. For a two-sash window pick two shades (left and right) or one group.

🪄 Prefer the wizard with circles and pictures, like in the card? **[Open the wizard with circles](/okno-ha)**

data_description.name: E.g. Living room. The device will be called “Okno Living room”.

okno.title: 🪟 Step 2 of 5: window and sensors
okno.description:
![]({obrazki}/kreator-pasek-2-en.png)

How many sashes the window has and whether it has open sensors. Sensors are optional.

data.wstecz: ⬅️ Go back to the previous step

data_description.czujnik_lewe: When the sensor shows open, the card draws an open sash.
data_description.tryb_lewe: How the card shows an open sash.
data_description.skrzydla: 1 = single sash, 2 = double window (left and right).
data_description.czujnik_prawe: Open sensor of the right sash. Leave empty if there is none.
data_description.tryb_prawe: How the right sash opens: tilted or opened sideways.
data_description.wstecz: Turn on and click “Next” to go one step back. What you entered stays.

silnik.title: ⚙️ Step 3 of 5: motor
silnik.description:
![]({obrazki}/kreator-pasek-3-en.png)

The card moves at the motor's pace. The motor speed was picked from the blind's device (if it has one, e.g. Moes). Calculated travel time: **{czas}**.

data.kalibruj: 🤖 Calibrate now (the blind goes up, down and up)
data.wstecz: ⬅️ Go back to the previous step

data_description.predkosc_lewa: The “…motor_speed” entity of the same blind. Leave empty if the motor has none.
data_description.predkosc_prawa: The same for the right sash.
data_description.czas: 0 = automatic: from motor speed or calibration.
data_description.kalibruj: Measures the real travel time and saves it. You can also do it later with the “Calibrate” button on the device.
data_description.wstecz: Turn on and click “Next” to go one step back. What you entered stays.

pogoda.title: 🌤️ Step 4 of 5: weather outside
pogoda.description:
![]({obrazki}/kreator-pasek-4-en.png)

Real weather shows outside the window. Leave empty and the card uses internet weather for your home.

data.wstecz: ⬅️ Go back to the previous step

data_description.pogoda: Weather outside the window on the card: sun, clouds, rain, snow, day and night. Leave empty and the card picks the first weather entity.
data_description.wstecz: Turn on and click “Next” to go one step back. What you entered stays.

wyglad.title: 🎨 Step 5 of 5: look
wyglad.description:
![]({obrazki}/kreator-pasek-5-en.png)

Pick the shade type and colours from the pictures below.

![Shade types]({obrazki}/oslony-kafle-v2-en.png)

![Shade colours]({obrazki}/kolory-v2-en.png)

![Frame colours]({obrazki}/ramy-v2-en.png)

data.na_panel: 📋 Add the window card to a dashboard
data.wstecz: ⬅️ Go back to the previous step

data_description.kolor: Samples are in the picture above.
data_description.kolor_wlasny: Click the circle and pick any colour. Replaces the list colour.
data_description.rama: Wood finishes are drawn with grain.
data_description.rama_wlasna: Any frame colour. Replaces the list colour.
data_description.oslona: What your shade looks like – compare with the tiles in the picture above.
data_description.wysokosc: How tall the window is on the card (pixels). Bigger = easier to see.
data_description.na_panel: The card appears on this dashboard by itself, with all settings from the wizard. Pick “Don't add” to place it yourself.
data_description.wstecz: Turn on and click “Next” to go one step back. What you entered stays.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant?
confirm.description: The new HA Window version ({wersja}) is downloaded. Click “Submit” and Home Assistant restarts (about a minute), then the new version runs.
